My dear friends, hello!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

We have released our first update, which fixes some bugs and steam achievements. 

If you have already completed the whole game, but you have not opened the achievements, then you need to go through any story chapter again. And then the statistics will be updated. Only 1u chapter, you can the very first.

Also, I want to note that many players have complained about the hardcore first story chapters. In connection with this, we lowered the difficulty.   

And once again, let me remind you that the game settings in the gameplay section has a lot of different options, such as free camera mode or sex mode on the chessboard.

notes.title: SEX CHESS!
notes.content:
The release of Sex Chess!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377801/8bef90c04a2e47494011f281a2b11b733a461a32.png

We faced a lot of obstacles on our way, but we finally managed to release the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377801/b15df91506dd0040491378b350bef73fd536d029.png

We worked very hard and hardly slept, as one of the team members dropped out of the project at the last minute and was unable to pass on some of the content to us. We had to make it from scratch in an emergency! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377801/b7b93517c64e47d13345ecddcf8b7ed5b844e391.png

At the moment our game is not perfect and contains some bugs and errors. 

Starting tomorrow we will start fixing them and adding new content! 

The future of Sex Chess depends on your support!

notes.title: The game will be released tomorrow!
notes.content:
The game will be released tomorrow! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377801/db2e2edd8de846b632d43c707b9fa9c717098e70.gif

Yes, that's the exact date! There will be no more postponements! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377801/64a4fb231fa4f1a9405e915546cd22a448b07849.gif

So get ready and wait! Everything will be fine! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377801/2ec9b37dcde8f3eed4f29e984f1267037df6c8b1.gif

There may be bugs in the release version of the game, but we'll try to fix them quickly! 

We look forward to your support and activity!

notes.title: Big Problems
notes.content:
Dear Friends.  

It is with great regret that I have to inform you that we have to postpone the release. This is the third time this has happened. Our technical specialist is living in a war zone. Due to shelling and power outages, he is unable to send me the final build. 

I have contacted steam tech support and notified them of this problem. As soon as I have up-to-date information - I will release the news. 

I ordered the keys to Sex with the Devil, as soon as I have them - I make a giveaway, it will be a small compensation.  

Once again, I apologize.
